items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: I'd never gone to Ben Barr's office for the petty cash or nothing

ctx.x: I'm at the Apollo Theater. Here I am admiring them. Here they come and asking me for some money, and I'm working as a side man in Lionel Hampton, and they'd starve in Houston. But in New York there was nothing. I didn't know that. See how you can be deceived and be disillusioned? And this is when I made up my mind. I said, this what it takes to deceive

people and be disillusioned. I'm going to start saving. Why, I don't want to be in this position no time down the road, and I started to prepare for (inaudible). I told you yesterday I took sick, had the spinal operation, had to go back and have it over, and when I come out of the hospital and I'd never gone to Ben Barr's office for the petty cash or nothing, I had one $700.00 left out of my savings and took part of that and bought a uniform for my band to start over again.
